chapter_title_en: The Death Castle and the Sea of Bones
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 2: The Death Castle and the Divine Stele – A Mythic Awakening
chapter_meta_description: In Chapter 2 of World of Immortality, Xiao Chen awakens on a tropical island after surviving the Death Castle. The chapter reveals the origin of his unique cultivation method—the Heaven-Bestowed Qi-Refining Diagram from the Yellow River Divine Stele—and sets up his reluctant journey in the World of Immortality. A tale of tragedy, myth, and survival begins.
